title: Stop requiring producers to run the full test suite
summary: Redo job h49d from the base: remove the producer's full-suite requirement and the run.rs send-back for it, keep Athena's post-producer checks, and amend every doc that states the old rule. The old CHANGELOG D95 entry stays with a note that D113 supersedes it, and the producer runs the full suite at most once.

defaults_applied.how: Behavior criteria run the lifecycle and job_plan tests, clippy and fmt.
Behavior criteria exercise the send-back and rejection paths.
Criteria check the behavior and wording, and name the grep to cite.
Fix every place the old rule is stated, not just the CHANGELOG line.
Docs cite job figures: six runs, 1800 s, 9 to 11 minutes.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Goal: producers stop rerunning the 9 to 11 minute full suite; audience is Athena operators and producers, and the verifier.
The code and prompt change is redone as the last attempt made it, since changes were discarded; only the docs differ (CHANGELOG D95 entry, D103/D95 pointers).
D113 is the next free decision number, as in the last attempt.
The older CHANGELOG D95 entry is kept with a supersession note, per the user's reply.
The producer runs the full suite at most once, per the user's reply.

acceptance_criteria.text: crates/athena-context/prompts/producer.md no longer tells the producer to run or report the full `cargo test --locked`. It says to run targeted tests (`cargo test -p <crate> <filter>`) while working and that Athena runs fmt, clippy and the full suite on the candidate.

In crates/athena-core/src/run.rs the producer loop no longer sends a report back for lacking a real full-suite result. The `ran_full_tests` and `tests_missing` gating and its send-back text are removed. The send-back for unmet acceptance criteria is kept. The producer-report-gaps note no longer tells the verifier to run the full suite.
The checks Athena runs on the candidate (fmt, clippy, full test) and their effect on the verdict are unchanged. The verifier prompt still says to cite recorded results.

Run `cargo test --locked -p athena-cli --test lifecycle` and `cargo test --locked -p athena-cli --test job_plan`. A producer report with no full-suite check, or with `not-run`, goes to the verifier without a send-back. A report with unmet criteria is still sent back once. A candidate whose recorded test check fails is still rejected.
Run `cargo clippy --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo fmt --check`. Both are clean, with no unused-code warnings from the removed gating.

docs/decisions.md has a new decision, D113, amending D95 and D103. The D95 and D103 entries each get a short pointer forward to D113. D113 states once that the earlier text stays as history, and gives the reason with the figures: job nvbb ran the suite six times and hit its 1800 s deadline, and a run takes 9 to 11 minutes.

CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased]: the older D95 entry (near line 624) is kept, not deleted, and gets a short note that D113 supersedes it. A D113 entry gives the same reason and figures. docs/design/athena-v0.md no longer says the producer must run the full suite.

A grep of decisions.md, athena-v0.md and CHANGELOG.md for 'full `cargo test --locked`', 'second miss' and 'ran_full_tests' finds no statement of the requirement outside quoted history or the supersession notes. The criterion evidence cites that search command and its output.

out_of_scope: Changing the post-producer fmt, clippy and full-suite checks or the verdict logic
Adding a new pre-handover wording-search gate
departures: Higher cost and time than the reference: the change spans code, tests and three docs, and the verifier's full-suite run takes 9 to 11 minutes.
